Telangana Man Feared Dead on Russian Frontline; Family Seeks Answers

A man from Kamareddy, Telangana, is feared dead on the Russian frontline, according to reports. He is identified as Khan, and is among four men from Telangana who were allegedly misled into joining the Russian Army. His family is seeking answers regarding his whereabouts and status.
